many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import numpy as np, json
def solve(I):
    I=np.array(I); O=I.copy()
    # find block: contiguous rows of 2s; take bbox of 2-cells
    mask=(I==2); ys,xs=np.where(mask)
    r0,r1=ys.min(),ys.max(); c0,c1=xs.min(),xs.max()
    B=r1-r0+1
    def fill(rows, noise_rows):
        # noise_cols = cols of noise (non-0 non-2) in given rows
        nc=set(c for r in rows for c,v in enumerate(I[r]) if v not in (0,2))
        cols=set(range(c0,c1+1))-nc
        for r in rows:
            O[r]=np.zeros_like(O[r]); O[r][cols]=2
            O[r][[c for c,v in enumerate(I[r]) if v not in (0,2)]]=I[r][[c for c,v in enumerate(I[r]) if v not in (0,2)]]
    fill(list(range(r0,r1+1)), list(range(r0,r1+1)))
    fill(list(range(0,r0)), list(range(0,r0)))   # top band: no further noise restriction
    fill(list(range(r1+1,O.shape[0])), list(range(r1+1,O.shape[0])))
    return O.tolist()
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    Ok=solve(G[k+' input'])
    print(k, Ok==G[k+' output'])

def f(T):
    I=np.array(T); H,W=I.shape
    ys,xs=np.where(I==2); r0,r1,c0,c1=ys.min(),ys.max(),xs.min(),xs.max()
    O=np.zeros_like(I)
    for r in range(H):
        nps=set(c for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=0 and I[r][c]!=2)
        if r<r0:                      # top band: block unchanged
            for c in range(c0,c1+1): O[r][c]=2
        elif r0<=r<=r1:              # mid band: fill away from noise
            if nps:
                ns=min(nps); ne=max(nps)
                if ne>c1:             # noise right of block -> grow left to 0
                    L,R=0,c1
                else:                 # noise inside/left -> grow right to edge
                    L,R=c0,W-1
                for c in range(L,R+1):
                    if c not in nps: O[r][c]=2
            else:
                for c in range(W): O[r][c]=2
        else:                         # bottom band: block minus noise cols, then hull
            ns=nps&set(range(c0,c1+1))
            cand=range(c0,c1+1)-ns
            if cand:
                L,R=(min(cand),max(cand))
                for c in range(W):
                    if L<=c<=R and c not in ns: O[r][c]=2
                    elif I[r][c]!=0: O[r][c]=I[r][c]
    return O.tolist()

def f(T):
    I=np.array(T); H,W=I.shape
    ys,xs=np.where(I==2); r0,r1,c0,c1=ys.min(),ys.max(),xs.min(),xs.max()
    allns=set(c for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=0 and I[r][c]!=2)
    O=np.zeros_like(I)
    for r in range(H):
        nps=allns & {c for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=0 and I[r][c]!=2} if False else None
        # per-row noise set for top/bottom S; for mid use direction
        rs=sorted(c for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=0 and I[r][c]!=2)
        if r<r0:                          # top: hull of block minus all-noise cols
            cand=[c for c in range(c0,c1+1) if c not in rs]
            L,R=(min(cand),max(cand)) if cand else (c0,c1)
            for c in range(L,R+1):
                if c not in rs: O[r][c]=2
        elif r0<=r<=r1:                  # mid: grow away from noise
            if rs:
                mn,mx=rs[0],rs[-1]
                if mx>c1: L,R=0,c1          # noise to the right
                else:     L,R=c0,W-1        # noise to the left
                for c in range(L,R+1):
                    if c not in rs: O[r][c]=2
            else:
                for c in range(W): O[r][c]=2
        else:                             # bottom: hull of block minus all-noise cols, same every row
            cand=[c for c in range(c0,c1+1) if c not in rs]
            L,R=(min(cand),max(cand)) if cand else (c0,c1)
            for c in range(L,R+1):
                if c not in rs: O[r][c]=2
    return O.tolist()

import numpy as np, json
T=G['Test input']; I=np.array(T)
ys,xs=np.where(I==2); r0,r1,c0,c1=ys.min(),ys.max(),xs.min(),xs.max()
W,H=I.shape
# above-block noise cols within span; below-block noise cols within span
above=set(c for r in range(r0) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if I[r][c]!=0 and I[r][c]!=2)
below=set(c for r in range(r1+1,H) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if I[r][c]!=0 and I[r][c]!=2)
O=np.zeros_like(I)
for r in range(H):
    if r<r0:                      # top: fill span minus above noise cols
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if c not in above: O[r][c]=2
    elif r0<=r<=r1:               # mid: no block noise -> fill whole row
        for c in range(W): O[r][c]=2
    else:                          # bottom: fill span minus below noise cols
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if c not in below: O[r][c]=2
    # keep original noise
    for c in range(W):
        if I[r][c]!=0 and I[r][c]!=2 and O[r][c]==0: O[r][c]=I[r][c]
# sanity: confirm rule reproduces demos? test only new formulation consistency first
print(json.dumps(O.tolist()))
